parallelGroups.note: ICS-II-B: students take EITHER Economics (Haroon) OR Statistics (Ishfaq), in parallel rooms. Structural slot range P3/P4.

dayExclusivePairs.note: Both courses are compulsory (no either/or): Math on 2 days (Najam), Stat on 2 days (Tanveer); the pair never shares a day (hard). Each course preferably on two consecutive days (soft). Applies to every BS SEM-I class offering both.

inter-1.natural: Multiple Periods in a Day for Same Subject: Not Allowed for intermediate level but allowed for BS level unless constrained by individual teacher.
Shuffling of Class Time for Same Subject over the Week: Avoid at the most
Non-Overriding Classes: Principle of Accounting and Principle of Economics in I.Com-I must have one non-overriding period in a week in each section
Classes on consecutive days: subject having 2 classes per week must be set on two consecutive days for intermediate level
Classes on Friday: Business Mathematics in I.Com must not be set on Friday
Individual Spread of classes: If a teacher in engaged in 1st period his last period should preferably be free

bs-1.natural: Multiple Periods in a Day for Same Subject: Not Allowed for intermediate level but allowed for BS level unless constrained by individual teacher.
Shuffling of Class Time for Same Subject over the Week: Avoid at the most
Off Days: Friday must be free for 7th semesters of BS
Off Periods: 1st and last periods must not be free for BS classes. Any free period in between must be marked "Library Work"

Combined classes: the four BSAF-VII x BSCM-VII pairs (Financial Reporting-I/Advanced Accounting Problems-I, Public Sector Accounting, Financial Modelling, Capstone Project) set at same slots in timetable
Individual Spread of classes: If a teacher in engaged in 1st period his last period should preferably be free
